gui_test_family: Exact - Proportion: Difference from constant (binomial test, one sample case)

gui_inputs.analysis: A priori: Compute required sample size - given α, power, and effect size

assumptions: G*Power parameterizes the one-sample binomial by effect size g = p_alternative - p_null = 0.50 - 0.30 = 0.20 alongside the constant proportion, rather than by the two proportions directly.
